name: annex-monorepo
description: Annex - the compliance compiler for AI systems.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @annex/engine && npm run build -w @annex/cli && npm run build -w @annex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @annex/engine && npm run typecheck -w @annex/cli && npm run typecheck -w @annex/web
scripts.selfscan: node packages/cli/dist/bin.js scan . --purpose "Compiles AI regulation into executable, evidence-producing controls over a source repository." --markets eu,us-federal
